tldr: Evening batch, Aug 28: WIRED finds OpenAI is building Codex 'Persistent mode' — agents that work until put to sleep, spawn their own follow-up tasks, and message you sparingly; OpenAI confirms testing, no launch date, and it's the same 'highly persistent' behavior behind the Hugging Face incident. Tencent open-sources Hy4-preview (770B MoE, 1M ctx, Apache 2.0) — its blind eval edges GLM-5.3 and Kimi K3, free on WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy for 2 weeks. Micron says HBM's silicon penalty is widening every generation (3x wafer area vs DDR5, compute outruns HBM bandwidth 3x/2yrs). Local stack: TontaubeV1 open 2.9B TTS for long-form speech, and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next hits 400 tps prefill on 2x RTX 3060 with the right llama.cpp flags. Beatport joins the anti-slop wave blocking fully AI-generated music. Plus Garry Tan's GStack cuts token load 50% and Anthropic's HIP Lab/METR third-party studies are underway.

articles.title: OpenAI is building Codex "Persistent mode" — agents that never stop
articles.summary: Found in Codex CLI code: agents keep working until put to sleep, spawn follow-up tasks, work across sessions. OpenAI confirms testing, no date.

articles.title: Tencent open-sources Hy4-preview — 770B MoE, 1M context, Apache 2.0
articles.summary: Weights on HF + ModelScope, FP8 included. Blind eval edges GLM-5.3 (2.99 vs 2.92) and Kimi K3; free on WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy for 2 weeks.

articles.title: Micron: HBM's silicon penalty is widening every generation
articles.summary: At Hot Chips 2026: HBM3E needs ~3x the wafer area of DDR5 for the same capacity — the gap widens each gen as compute outruns HBM bandwidth 3x/2yrs.

articles.title: TontaubeV1 — open 2.9B TTS for local long-form speech
articles.summary: Two-person release: expressive, long-form, low-latency synthesis with zero-shot voice cloning (English + German), built for local inference.

articles.title: Beatport now blocks fully AI-generated music
articles.summary: Every upload scanned via Beatdapp; AI-assisted human tracks get tagged instead. Joins Bandcamp/Tidal/Spotify in the anti-slop wave.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on 2x RTX 3060 — 36 to 400 tps prefill
articles.summary: -sm layer instead of tensor fixed prefill (36→135 tps); -ubatch 2048 hit 400 tps at 131K ctx. UD-IQ4_XS fits consumer dual-GPU rigs.

articles.title: Garry Tan's GStack cuts token load 50% with no capability loss
articles.summary: YC CEO open-sources efficiency-first agent stack on GitHub — halves token spend while keeping capability, a reference point for agent cost design.

articles.title: Anthropic runs third-party studies on Claude's behavioral impact
articles.summary: HIP Lab studies how Claude's behavior relates to how people feel using AI; METR measures real-world coding-agent productivity gains. Results soon.
